name: 여성 측량사
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent sprite atlas for historical maritime RPG, detailed realistic painterly game illustration. Reference 1 is the original adult woman's head-to-knees outfit, reference 2 is her face. Preserve EXACT same adult woman's face, hair, opaque clothing, colors, short skirt/shorts, armor, accessories and body proportions, complete her legs with the same practical tall leather boots. Keep occupational tools, books, bows, quiver and map cases secured at belt or back. Wield ONLY ONE simple gold-guard European rapier/saber in her RIGHT hand. Anatomically correct five-digit grip: four fingers wrap around and occlude the leather hilt, thumb opposes over fingers, guard in front of knuckles, pommel behind little finger. Blade firmly attached to hilt; wrist connected naturally to forearm. No floating weapons, disconnected handles, extra limbs, extra fingers, gore or motion trails. EXACTLY 24 fully visible full-body poses in STRICT 6 columns by 4 rows, landscape 2304x1536. All whole figures including boots, fingers, sword tips and cloth safely inside their equal cells with generous transparent gutters. Consistent same body scale, camera, right-facing three-quarter side view. Genuine ALPHA ZERO background everywhere outside silhouettes, no floor, shadows, white/gray haze, background, labels, text, watermarks or grid lines. Do not crop any figure or sword tip. Four rows in exact left-to-right order. Row 1 parry (neutral ready, high guard, blade parry, bracing, relax, neutral). Row 2 defense (guard, low guard, middle guard, stepping back, regain balance, neutral). Row 3 hit reaction (flinch, recoil, clutch side with free hand, stumble back, regain balance, neutral). Row 4 EXACTLY: 1 neutral standing sword low; 2 command raised free hand; 3 kneel on ONE knee; 4 collapsing low; 5 LYING COMPLETELY FLAT HORIZONTALLY ON THE GROUND in side view, full extended body head to boots, width at least THREE TIMES its height, no raised knees or torso; 6 rising to kneel. The prone figure in row 4 column 5 must fit horizontally in its own square cell, with entire head, hair and boots visible. No blood, no wounds. Every full figure surrounded by transparent margins, maximum 78% of cell height including raised hands.
